| 0x139E7D0 | Block start inside the settings-update routine, mid-function (no push, no prologue): reads the byte flag at object+552, tests bit 2 and jumps straight to 0x139E800 when it is set, so the helper lookup and the virtual call below run only while the bit is clear. Being one of eight addresses that SUYU lists for a single source line, this line compiles to a whole multi-block condition, not to a single test. | game_settings.cpp:1207 | PLAUSIBLE | `ldrb r0, [r4, #552]` / `bne 0x139e800` |
| 0x139E7DC | Fall-through of that bit test, i.e. the bit-clear path (mid-function, no prologue): loads a pointer from the caller stack slot [sp+8], dereferences it and calls helper 0x13A05A0 with r1 = r8 >> 16 as the index; a non-zero result bails back to 0x139E664 and only a zero result reaches the shared path at 0x139E800. The `bne` at 0x139E7D8 skips this lookup entirely, so the flag at +552 gates a lookup-then-dispatch sequence. | game_settings.cpp:1207 | PLAUSIBLE | `ldr r0, [sp, #8]` / `mov r1, r8, lsr #16` / `bl 0x13a05a0` |
| 0x139E7EC | Decision block of the same line, mid-function (entered by fall-through from 0x139E7DC; the neighbouring block at 0x139E7F8, which calls 0x13A6464 on r9, joins later at 0x139E800): compares the helper result with 0 and rejoins 0x139E800; there it reloads the vtable pointer from [r4], takes the slot at +60, calls it as (this = r4, arg = r6) with `blx`, and compares the return value with 1. Only a return of 1 falls into the epilogue at 0x139E81C (stack teardown of 132 bytes, then pop r4-r11/pc); every other outcome branches back to 0x139E664. The epilogue is direct evidence that 0x139E7EC..0x139E820 is the final block of the enclosing function and that 0x139E824 onward is data (`.word 0x004A2A44`), which is exactly why SUYU's address list for this line ends at 0x139E7EC. | game_settings.cpp:1207 | VERIFIED | `blx r2` / `pop {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, pc}` |
